content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A digital product store without KYC payments fundamentally changes the way creators can sell their work. By utilizing a decentralized payment system, you can bypass the fees and restrictions imposed by traditional platforms. For example, while Gumroad takes a hefty 10% of your sales, using NOWPayments only costs 0.5%. At 100 sales a month on a $97 product, this means retaining an additional $921 — money that can be reinvested into your business or used to enhance your offerings. This model not only increases your profits but also empowers you with full control over your e-commerce operations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a no-KYC digital product store relies on a stack of open-source tools and decentralized payment solutions. At its core, you can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your digital storefront. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers can handle backend logic, automating processes like payment verification and product delivery. By integrating NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, avoiding KYC obligations entirely. This infrastructure ensures that you own everything post-deployment, creating a truly sovereign commerce experience without relying on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators in regions facing payment processing barriers, such as Nigeria, Ghana, or Venezuela. If you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or other digital goods and have been hindered by conventional platforms, this infrastructure is for you. By architecting your own store using COREMERCH's tools, you can operate independently and efficiently. This approach not only enhances your revenue potential but also establishes a reliable, long-term solution for your digital sales needs.
You retain 99.5% of your sales with NOWPayments compared to traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful no-KYC digital product store consists of several key components working in harmony. First, you need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to display your products. Then, backend logic is handled by Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, processing orders and verifying payments. NOWPayments serves as your payment processor, enabling seamless transactions in various cryptocurrencies. By utilizing tools like Supabase or Google Sheets for order tracking and management, you gain full oversight and control of your sales without any ongoing fees.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your no-KYC digital product store, start by selecting a hosting service like GitHub Pages. Then, set up a backend using Google Apps Script to automate your order process. Register for NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions and configure your product listings. Utilize Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your orders and track sales data. Finally, ensure that your product delivery mechanism — either through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 — is functioning properly. By following these steps, you can launch your digital store quickly and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a no-KYC payment solution like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly without facing traditional banking restrictions. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can establish control over your sales and keep more of your revenue, avoiding platform fees.
Owning your digital store means no fees beyond the transaction cost.

This kit includes everything from blueprints to templates, enabling you to build and scale your own digital store. Explore the offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store. 2. Set up backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. 3. Register with NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. 4. Create product listings and set up order management with Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Ensure product delivery is configured through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital downloads without platform fees?

You can sell digital downloads by implementing a no-KYC payment solution like NOWPayments alongside your own hosting and backend infrastructure. This allows you to avoid platform fees entirely and keep more revenue.
What are the alternatives to Gumroad for selling digital products?

Consider using a self-hosted solution that leverages tools like Google Apps Script and NOWPayments. This setup allows you to sell products without incurring the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad.
Can I accept payments in cryptocurrencies easily?

Yes, by integrating NOWPayments with your digital storefront, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies seamlessly. This integration works without the need for KYC, making it easier to access a global market.
Is it possible to automate product delivery?
Absolutely. By using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate product delivery, ensuring that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
What do I need to start selling digital products online?
To start selling digital products online, you'll need a hosting platform, a payment processor like NOWPayments, a backend solution for order management, and a secure method for product delivery.
